name: panel bed
caption: A panel bed with a slatted headboard, a matching footboard and four legs. A mattress rests on the frame; curved headboard and footboard join the frame sides. Rounded frame edges carry their continuously attached supports. Overall width is 1.35 times depth; height is 0.55 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous cream, dark brown, tan color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
